HomeTeam Live Technologies Inc. (HTN)

About Us

HTN is a Canadian-headquartered sports technology company with teams across North and South America. We build live streaming and AI-powered video products that help sports organizations broadcast games and engage fans. We're a lean, product-focused team where engineers own their work from database to UI and see it in front of viewers every game day.

The Engagement

We're looking for mid-level Full Stack Engineers based in Cebu City to join our engineering team on a long-term contract basis. This is a remote, contractor engagement administered through a Contractor of Record service, with fees paid semi-monthly in USD.

Your work will cover two areas. First, you'll build and improve features across our web and mobile platforms. Second, you'll provide engineering coverage outside North American business hours. That means monitoring system health, responding to incidents, and serving as the technical escalation point for our TechOps and Customer Support teams when real platform issues come up.

To do this well, you'll learn our platform in depth: how it's built, how its services connect, and how it behaves under load. When something goes wrong, you'll be the person who can diagnose it and fix it or contain it.

Scope of Work

Platform Reliability & Escalation

  • Monitor system performance, availability, and alerts during hours not covered by our North American team.
  • Act as the engineering escalation path for TechOps and Customer Support, and separate true platform issues from user or configuration problems.
  • Investigate and resolve production incidents, or stabilize them and hand them off clearly to the North American team.
  • Document incidents, root causes, and fixes, and help build runbooks so recurring problems get resolved faster.
  • Identify recurring issues and performance bottlenecks, and propose or build lasting fixes.

Development

  • Design, build, and ship end-to-end features across our web applications, APIs, and back-end services.
  • Develop and maintain services that support live video delivery, media processing, and customer-facing tools.
  • Write clean, tested, maintainable code and take part in code reviews.
  • Improve observability through logging, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5 years of professional full stack development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in [TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern front-end framework].
  • Back-end experience.
  • E-commerce experience.
  • Experience building and consuming REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Experience running production applications in a cloud environment [AWS / GCP / Azure].
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting production systems using logs, metrics, and monitoring tools.
  • Calm, methodical judgment under pressure, and the ability to work independently when the rest of the team is offline.
  • Clear written & spoken English. You'll be writing incident updates and handoffs that others act on.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with video streaming or real-time media technologies.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch, Sentry, or PagerDuty.
  • Previous on-call, SRE, or production support experience.
  • Exposure to AI/ML-powered products.
  • Experience working with North American teams, especially as a contractor.

Coverage & Availability

This engagement provides coverage outside North American business hours, which largely falls during the Philippine daytime. Contractors agree to defined coverage windows, including a share of weekend coverage, since live sports happen on evenings and weekends. Some regular overlap with our Canadian team is needed for handoffs and collaboration.

What We Offer

  • A competitive monthly fee paid in USD
  • A long-term, full-time-equivalent engagement.
  • Fully remote work.
  • Contracting, invoicing, and payments handled through a Contractor of Record service.
  • Deep ownership of a live production platform at a growing sports-tech company.

Pay: Up to Php135,000.00 per month

Benefits:

  • Work from home

Work Location: Remote

About Berny

Berny is a Melbourne-founded product company building AI-powered products for a wide range of customers. We combine deep domain expertise with modern AI tools to solve problems that conventional software cannot.

We also use AI to improve the way we build software, making our engineering teams more efficient and innovative.

As we continue to grow our engineering team in Clark, we're looking for developers who take ownership, enjoy solving problems, and are eager to expand their skills across the full technology stack.

About the Role

We're looking for a Mid-Level Full Stack Engineer who can build and deliver features across web applications, backend services, and mobile platforms.

In this role, you'll work with technologies such as React, TypeScript, Node.js, .NET, and React Native. You'll take ownership of features from understanding requirements and planning solutions to implementation, testing, and deployment.

You'll also work in an AI-assisted engineering environment, using AI coding agents to accelerate development while applying your technical judgment to review, test, and validate their output.

You don't need to be an expert in every technology from day one. However, you should have solid experience in at least one modern web/backend stack and be willing to develop your capabilities across the full stack, including mobile development.

Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Development

  • Design, develop, and deliver features across frontend, backend, and mobile applications.
  • Build responsive web interfaces using React and TypeScript.
  • Develop and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js or .NET.
  • Contribute to mobile application development using React Native or other relevant technologies.
  • Take ownership of assigned features from initial requirements through production release.
  • Ensure your work is reliable, maintainable, and properly documented.

AI-Assisted Engineering

  • Use AI coding agents to support and accelerate software development.
  • Provide clear instructions and context to AI agents, then review and validate their generated code.
  • Identify potential issues, errors, and limitations in AI-generated implementations.
  • Contribute to improving AI-assisted development practices and engineering workflows.

Testing, Quality, and Security

  • Write and maintain automated tests, including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain development standards.
  • Work with CI/CD pipelines and support reliable deployment processes.
  • Apply secure coding practices and consider performance, reliability, and maintainability.

Technical Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Design, and QA teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
  • Participate in technical and architectural discussions.
  • Contribute to API design, data models, and improvements to shared systems.
  • Communicate progress, raise potential blockers, and manage assigned tasks responsibly.
  • Support junior developers through constructive code reviews and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • 2–5 years of professional experience in software development.
  • Experience developing and maintaining production software applications.
  • Strong working knowledge of at least one modern web/backend technology stack, such as:
  • React and Node.js
  • React and .NET
  • Experience with React and TypeScript is highly valued.
  • Exposure to React Native or native mobile development is an advantage. Candidates without extensive mobile experience should demonstrate a strong willingness and ability to learn.
  • Experience using AI coding tools or AI agents in actual software development projects.
  • Good understanding of software testing, debugging, Git, and CI/CD practices.
  • Ability to understand technical requirements and translate them into working solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Willingness to work across frontend, backend, and mobile technologies as project requirements evolve.
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Clark, Pampanga.

Pay: From Php40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

  • Flextime
  • Opportunities for promotion
  • Promotion to permanent employee
  • Work from home

Application Question(s):

  • Describe a production application or software project you have developed or maintained. What was the purpose of the application, which technologies did you use, and what specific features or components did you personally build?
  • Tell us about a project where you worked across both frontend and backend development. How did you connect the user interface to the backend services, and what challenges did you encounter during implementation?
  • What is your current location, and what is your availability to work onsite in Clark, Pampanga?
  • When would you be available to start?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Clark Freeport Zone

About True North Insights

True North Insights is a global expert network that connects organizations with subject matter experts who provide critical insights to inform strategic decision-making.

We believe the right knowledge can move the world forward. Since day one, that belief has driven everything we do. We exist to break through complexity, giving global investors and business leaders frictionless access to the insights that matter most — insights that fuel confident decisions, unlock opportunity, and power successful careers.

Founded in 2019 in New York City, our firm has skyrocketed from launch to becoming #7 in North America and #10 globally in just five years — and we're just getting started. As we expand into Europe and beyond, there's never been a better time to join our high-growth, global team.


Looking for excellence and something to be proud of? Look no further. Step into a high-energy, high-intensity, KPI-driven role with unlimited growth.

  • This job is a night shift fixed schedule supporting our NYC office
  • Hybrid work environment, 3 days on-site in Makati. 5 Days on-site are required during the initial training period. WFH is permissible up to 2 days per week in non-training periods.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on full-stack engineer to become a foundational member of our engineering team.

You will join and help lead a team with end-to-end ownership of a web-based database application at the center of our interactions with experts and clients. Your work will span technical design, backend and database development, third-party API integration, front-end delivery, deployment, and production support.

This is a high-autonomy role for an engineer who enjoys working close to the business. You will partner directly with product, operations, and other frontline stakeholders to review and solve high-priority software problems, evaluate opportunities based on return on investment, and deliver practical software that improves how our teams operate.

You will also help establish the technical practices and operating standards for a growing engineering organization. Over the following six months, you will participate in interviewing, hiring, and mentoring additional engineers joining the team.

What You'll Do

  • Take full ownership of "the how" regarding major product features, from architectural approach and technical design through implementation, quality assurance, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
  • Design, build, and maintain reliable backend services using Java and Spring.
  • Maintain and evolve our database architecture, data models, and queries to support performance, reliability, and future scale.
  • Build and harden front-end features to production quality, collaborating with product and using AI-assisted design and development tools where appropriate.
  • Work directly with product, operations, and front-line team members to understand workflows, identify inefficiencies, and design effective software solutions.
  • Develop a strong understanding of our fast-moving business and help prioritize technical investments based on customer impact, operational value, and ROI.
  • Use AI-assisted coding tools, such as Codex, Claude Code, or similar platforms, as a regular part of your development workflow while maintaining high standards for testing, review, security, and maintainability.
  • Deploy, monitor, and support applications running on AWS, including cloud maintenance and security in accordance with ISO 27001 and 27701 frameworks, contributing to the reliability and operational maturity of our production environment.
  • Participate in a shared production-support rotation during New York business hours, initially in partnership with our New York-based engineer.
  • Help design the incident-response, monitoring, documentation, and on-call practices that the growing engineering team will use.
  • Contribute to technical architecture, engineering standards, development processes, and decisions about when to improve existing systems versus introduce new technologies.
  • Participate in interviewing and selecting backend, frontend, and platform engineers as the team grows.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and thoughtful code and design reviews to other engineers.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university required. A degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field is preferred but not required.
  • Typically 8 or more years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent evidence of Staff-level technical ownership and impact.
  • Deep professional experience with backend development, including ownership of database-driven web applications in production.
  • Strong proficiency in Java and hands-on experience with Spring or Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience with relational database design, data modeling, performance optimization, and production database management.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to write and optimize queries used for application functionality, troubleshooting, reporting, and business intelligence.
  • Professional experience contributing to front-end web applications and the ability to deliver production-quality user-facing features.
  • Experience deploying, operating, monitoring, and troubleshooting production applications on AWS.
  • Demonstrated ownership of production systems throughout their lifecycle, including incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term reliability improvements.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted coding tools, such as Codex, Claude Code, or similar tools, as part of a regular software-development workflow.
  • Experience implementing technical controls in environments subject to GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or comparable security and privacy requirements.
  • Strong product and business judgment, including the ability to translate operational problems into appropriately scoped technical solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the confidence to work directly with engineers, product, operations, and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working with a high degree of autonomy, making sound technical decisions, and communicating tradeoffs clearly.
  • Ability to maintain regular working-hour overlap with U.S. Eastern time for real-time collaboration and production support.
  • Strong accountability, follow-through, and time-management skills in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience would be valuable, but we do not expect every candidate to have all of it:

  • Strong experience with Vue.js or another modern JavaScript front-end framework.
  • Experience with Kotlin.
  • Experience with Python.
  • Experience integrating generative AI models or AI-powered capabilities into production applications.
  • Experience building AI-enabled CRM, workflow, search, or knowledge-management features.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, observability, cloud security, or other platform-engineering practices.
  • Experience working effectively across time zones in a distributed or remote-first engineering organization.
  • Previous experience interviewing, hiring, mentoring, or providing technical leadership to other engineers.
  • Relevant and current AWS, security, database, or software architecture certifications.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first several months, you will:

  • Build a strong understanding of the application, its architecture, and the business workflows it supports.
  • Take ownership of meaningful product features across the backend, database, and front end.
  • Establish trusted working relationships with our New York-based engineer and Product and Operations stakeholders.
  • Improve the reliability, maintainability, monitoring, and documentation of the production system.
  • Help establish practical production support and incident-response practices.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining clear accountability for code quality and system behavior.
  • Contribute to the hiring and onboarding of the engineers who will form the next stage of the team.
  • Help create a technical foundation that allows the engineering organization to grow without losing speed, quality, or connection to the business.

Why True North Insights

True North Insights offers a dynamic, high-performance culture where ambitious professionals grow quickly and own meaningful work from day one.

  • Join the Manila office of one of the world's fastest-growing expert networks.
  • You will work alongside our HQ in NYC. Be part of a fun, friendly, and family-oriented culture.
  • Diverse project exposure.
  • Compensation: Gross monthly base salary of PHP 160,000-PHP 250,000 (inclusive of night differentials), depending on relevant experience, technical depth, leadership experience, and demonstrated alignment with the scope of the role.
  • Discretionary annual performance bonus of up to 8% of annual base salary.
  • Benefits: Day 1 HMO for the employee, life insurance, vacation leave, US holiday leave, paid sick leave, 13th month, and government/social benefits.
  • Monthly transportation allowance of PHP 1,200
  • Perks: Free snacks, paid trainings, Monday breakfast, and regular team events.

At True North Insights, growth is earned—not given. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to lead.

Solve Outsource Inc.

Full-time | 10:00 AM–7:00 PM Manila Time

Build Real Applications. Work Smarter with AI. Grow Your Development Career.

Are you a junior developer who loves experimenting with AI coding tools and turning ideas into working applications?

At Solve Outsource Inc., we're looking for a hands-on Junior Full-Stack & AI Developer who actively uses tools like Claude, Claude Code, and other AI-assisted development platforms to build, test, and improve software.

This isn't a role where you'll spend your days watching tutorials or doing repetitive coding exercises. You'll contribute to real business applications, process automation, system migrations, and internal tools that help our team work smarter.

You'll work directly with our Director and receive technical guidance and code reviews from an experienced engineer, giving you the opportunity to strengthen your skills while delivering meaningful results.

What You'll Work On

1. AI-Powered Application Development

  • Help rebuild our internal task management system using Claude Code, including data migration.
  • Develop and test features for web applications using AI-assisted coding tools.
  • Contribute to our client portal and employee application.

2. System Migration & Data Management

  • Support the migration of server files to Microsoft SharePoint.
  • Help organise files, metadata, and information structures.
  • Validate migrated data to ensure accuracy and completeness.

3. Business Process Automation

  • Identify manual tasks that could be automated.
  • Build practical automations with the Solve team.
  • Help colleagues understand and use the tools you develop.

4. Quality, Testing & Continuous Improvement

  • Review and test AI-generated code rather than blindly accepting its output.
  • Use Git and version control to manage changes.
  • Follow testing, documentation, and code review standards.
  • Raise technical issues early and apply feedback to improve your work.

What We're Looking For

We're interested in practical ability, curiosity, and a genuine interest in building software with AI.

Essential requirements:

  • 1–3 years of software development experience, or a strong portfolio of relevant projects.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Basic SQL and database fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience building projects with Claude Code or similar AI coding tools.
  • Ability to explain how you test, debug, and verify AI-generated code.
  • Familiarity with Git and version control.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and openness to code review.

Nice to have:

  • React or Next.js.
  • Node.js or Python.
  • Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.
  • Workflow automation tools such as n8n or Power Automate.
  • Azure or another cloud platform.
  • A degree or certification in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

Your portfolio matters. If you have built useful applications, automated a workflow, created an internal tool, or used AI coding assistants to develop a working project, we want to see what you can do.

What You'll Get

  • ₱50,000–₱90,000 monthly salary, depending on experience and demonstrated skills.
  • 13th-month pay.
  • HMO coverage.
  • Statutory benefits: SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG.
  • 20 days of paid leave.
  • AI tool subscriptions and work equipment provided.
  • Direct exposure to real software development projects.
  • Guidance and code reviews from an experienced engineer.
  • Opportunities to expand your full-stack, AI-assisted development, and automation skills.

Employment: Full-time regular employment, with a six-month probationary period.
Work arrangement: Remote / hybrid in the Philippines.
Working hours: 10:00 AM–7:00 PM Philippine Time. Ready to Apply?

Send us your CV and a link to your GitHub profile, portfolio, or working projects.

Pay: Php50,000.00 - Php90,000.00 per month

Benefits:

  • Additional leave
  • Health insurance

Experience:

  • Full Stack developement: 2 years (Preferred)
  • Ai development: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

Full Stack Engineer

Role Objective: You will take our existing React designs and build the production system behind them: the APIs, the data, sign-in and security, and deployment on AWS. You’ll own the product end to end, from the first commit to running it in production.

Must-have qualifications

1. Full-stack product engineering (top priority) Strong experience building and shipping web applications end to end in TypeScript: React on the frontend, Node or Python APIs on the backend, and deployment to AWS with infrastructure as code (CDK preferred) and CI/CD across test and production environments. You’ll turn existing React designs for our clinician and patient apps into a production product backed by real data and APIs.

2. Relational data modeling (Postgres) Solid experience designing Postgres schemas for linked records (patients, visits, labs, prescriptions, orders), including migrations, query performance and reliable data exports for analytics and curated datasets.

3. APIs, authentication and security Solid grounding in API design, authentication (OIDC, JWT) and fine-grained access control. Security and access design run through the whole platform, including careful management of secrets and credentials for the third-party services we integrate with.

4. Experience 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and shipping production systems end to end. You’ve taken at least one product from nothing to live use with real customers and owned it afterward. Startup or early-team experience strongly preferred.

Nice to have

● Experience turning a science or AI model into a reliable service on AWS that apps can call.

● Experience with ML services such as SageMaker or Bedrock.

Who you are

You want to own a product end to end, not one piece of it. You’re comfortable being an early engineer on a small team: you make decisions, ship quickly, and fix what you built when it breaks.

Benefits:

  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Work from home

Application Question(s):

  • Do you have at least 5 years of experience building and deploying full-stack applications using React, TypeScript, and Node.js or Python?
  • Have you built and launched a production application from scratch and maintained it after launch? Briefly describe your experience.
  • What is your experience designing and managing PostgreSQL databases, including data relationships, migrations, and query optimization?
  • Have you implemented APIs, authentication using OIDC or JWT, and role-based access control to secure applications and user data?
  • What is your experience deploying applications on AWS using infrastructure as code, such as AWS CDK, and setting up CI/CD pipelines?
  • Have you integrated AI or machine learning models into production applications using AWS SageMaker, Bedrock, or similar services? Briefly describe your experience.
  • What is your email address and phone no?

Work Location: Remote

Elgada BPO Solutions Inc. is a growing business solution provider based in the heart of Makati, Philippines. We support the ever-growing demands of our offshore client through software development.

Using our tech expertise and cross-industry experience, we evolve digital transformation into digital acceleration. We deliver full-cycle software development services that adapt seamlessly to project requirements and business needs.

Job Summary

We are hiring for skilled Full Stack AI Engineers with strong experience in PHP and React.js to help build, enhance, and maintain web applications within an AI-powered environment. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across the full development stack, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and integrating AI-driven features into scalable, secure applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain full stack web applications using PHP (backend) and React.js (frontend)
  • Build and consume RESTful APIs and integrate third-party services, including AI/ML tools and APIs
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and AI/data teams to translate requirements into technical solutions
  • Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and security
  • Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code
  • Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues across the stack
  • Participate in code reviews and follow best practices for version control and deployment
  • Support continuous improvement of development processes and system architecture

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer
  • Strong proficiency in PHP (any modern framework such as Laravel, Symfony, or similar is a plus)
  • Solid experience with React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, and CSS
  • Experience building and consuming APIs
  • Familiarity with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Understanding of basic AI concepts and experience integrating AI-related tools or APIs
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Willing to work 2 days onsite in Makati City from 5:00PM to 2:00AM Philippine Time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with AI/ML platforms or services (e.g., OpenAI, cloud AI services, custom models)
  • Knowledge of Node.js, Python, or other supporting languages
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (Docker, etc.)
  • Experience working in agile or startup environments

Additional Perks:

  • Hybrid work set up (Onsite every Wednesday and Friday in Makati City)
  • Full-Time Employment
  • HMO coverage on day 1
  • 13th-month pay
  • Annual Performance Reviews
  • Philippine Holidays and Client Holidays
  • Work life balance with fixed weekends off
  • NO Shifting schedule
  • Government-mandated benefits
  • Employee Engagement Events (company outings, fun activities)
  • Have the opportunity to work with a team of programmers and IT professionals and work directly with the client (US Based - SaaS Company).
